```sh
./docsis docs           # regenerate
```

## Where to start

Run it once, then read the capture:

```sh
./docsis run
open captures/docsis.pcapng
./docsis pcap                 # or a text summary
```

`DOCSIS-NOTES.md` follows the same sequence in prose. `REFERENCE.md` is for when you are staring at a byte and want to know what it means.
